name: chronobite-fullstack
description: ChronoBite Food Delivery Platform — Unified Full-Stack Application

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix frontend/customer-app && npm install --prefix frontend/admin-dashboard && npm install --prefix backend && npm run build

author: ChronoBite Team
